Independent source parameterizations, not a combined fit. Thompson (2008) static BM3 is the room-temperature default; Zhao (1998) thermal BM3 supplies the published high-temperature parameterization. Equation and parameter parity are established within source precision and reported errors after accounting for a graph-corroborated table error. Original observations and published coefficients are preserved; source-table discrepancies are recorded as provenance. See docs/literature-reproductions/diopside.md. Conventional Z=4 cell volumes; mechanical P-V-T models do not define caloric free energies.

<details markdown="1">
<summary>Parameter provenance</summary>

- **Origin of the parameterization:** Isothermal compression and/or simultaneous P-V-T diffraction measurements; no acoustic or adiabatic bulk modulus is substituted.
- **Equation:** Zhao (1998), Equation (1), page 26: third-order Eulerian finite strain, with VT=V0 exp(integral alpha dT), alpha=a+bT, KT=KT0+dK/dT\*(T-300 K), Kprime independent of T.
- **V0:** 438.67 A^3 is the printed 300 K ambient volume in Table 1 rows 1 and 32, used as the ambient volume defined by Equation (1). The source does not separately give a fitted V0 or specify whether it was refined. Its observed error 0.06 A^3 is retained in the dataset, not relabeled as a regression error.
- **K0:** 109.1 GPa and Kprime=4.84 in abstract and Figure 2; rounded prose 109(4) GPa and 4.8(6) supplies reported errors.
- **K0 prime:** Figure 2 and abstract: 4.84; prose reports 4.8(6). Page 27 pressure-correction demonstration instead uses 4.85 and dK/dT=-0.0206; those alternate rounded numbers are not mixed in.
- **Reference temperature (K):** Equation (1) explicitly anchors KT at 300 K; integration is anchored there so VT(300)=V0.
- **Thermal:** Page 26 final paragraph: a=2.32(5)e-5 K^-1, b=1.88(7)e-8 K^-2, dK/dT=-2.05(4)e-2 GPa/K. a is the T=0 intercept, not alpha at 300 K. c/T^2 and higher T derivatives are neglected by the source.

</details>
